info.title: OpenRouter Data Archive API
info.description: Independent, unofficial daily public OpenRouter archive and read-only JSON/RSS API. Discover all 28 catalogue, performance, public usage/ranking, content and documentation datasets through catalog/feeds. Official URLs are source attribution, not this deployment. New public statistics use anonymous page-backed frontend interfaces whose undocumented schemas, selected top rows, sampled/fractional estimates, windows and unknown units are explicitly preserved. They are not private/account data, complete traffic or infinite history. Partial attempts and dataset-specific retained successful fallbacks expose real source snapshot/time, attempt identity, errors and stale status. schema_version remains 1 for old archive compatibility. Raw source bodies and complete payloads are retained with query chunk indexes where needed; credential-shaped official examples are explicitly redacted with original/published hashes. HEAD mirrors GET status/headers; OPTIONS returns 204. All query parameters are strict. Dataset-specific attribution identifies the applicable source and licence scope without assigning one licence to all third-party data. Coverage/discovery report summaries omit physical indexes, expose summary/chunk counts, and link to the complete manifest. Delivery may use lossless public-index/query-manifest projections and logical-path .gz transport fallbacks; compression does not change source timestamps, row counts or logical decoded-byte hashes. storage.json records delivery/compression information, while legacy plain files remain supported. Authenticated Data API/account data is not enabled.

get.description: Query parameters are strict: unknown names, duplicate keys and inapplicable filters return 400. Comma-separated values use OR within each field and AND across fields; exact filters are case insensitive and comma-separated values are individually trimmed. All results come from stored snapshots, with no live upstream query. Collection dates are UTC, distinct from model creation/publication dates. History begins with actual successful collection, with no invented backfill. A zero-match query on a successfully collected dataset is a valid empty result. dimension is rejected on this endpoint. Failed selected attempts or unavailable selected datasets return 503. API v1.1 can select a partial attempt. Successful datasets are served from that attempt; a failed dataset with a retained successful fallback returns HTTP 200 with meta.status=stale, the old actual meta.snapshot/data_collected_at, and the current attempt_snapshot/snapshot_status. No fallback means 503. Large source datasets can be stored in complete raw archives plus query chunks/model_chunks; model-filtered requests load matching chunks and preserve complete matching row payloads.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: One archived dataset, discovered through /api/v1/catalog or /feeds.json. All 28 catalogue/statistic/content/document datasets are queryable when collected. Missing historical datasets return 503, never an invented empty success.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: UTC collection date or latest. latest chooses index.latest_snapshot (usable success/partial), with legacy last_success fallback. An exact date chooses the latest success/partial run on that date, never nearest-date substitution. Mutually exclusive with snapshot; history begins with actual collection.

parameters.name: snapshot
parameters.description: Exact attempt run ID. Mutually exclusive with date. Failed attempts can be inspected through manifest/datasets/catalogue; row queries reject failed snapshots. A partial run can serve successful datasets and explicitly stale per-dataset fallbacks.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring across row identity, name, description and title. Empty strings are rejected.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Comma-separated exact, case-insensitive scalar model identities. Applicable types are listed in x-applicable-types; unsupported types return 400. Model identity can be a native id/model_permaslug/variant_permaslug or catalogue-request model_id, depending on the row. Whole nested payloads are not recursively filtered.

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Comma-separated exact, case-insensitive author prefixes before / in row identity. Applicable types are listed in x-applicable-types; unsupported types return 400. Model identity can be a native id/model_permaslug/variant_permaslug or catalogue-request model_id, depending on the row. Whole nested payloads are not recursively filtered.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Comma-separated exact provider names/slugs/tags present on the row or _source.provider. Uses actual provider fields, never an invented catalogue author-to-provider relationship. Applicable types are listed in x-applicable-types; unsupported types return 400.

parameters.name: input_modality
parameters.description: Comma-separated exact architecture.input_modalities values. Valid only for models, embedding_models, eu_models, image_models. Other datasets return 400.

parameters.name: output_modality
parameters.description: Comma-separated exact architecture.output_modalities values. Valid only for models, embedding_models, eu_models, image_models. Other datasets return 400.

parameters.name: parameter
parameters.description: Comma-separated exact supported parameter names, from array values or object keys. Valid only for models, embedding_models, eu_models, image_models, endpoints, image_endpoints, zdr_endpoints. Other datasets return 400.

parameters.name: min_context
parameters.description: Minimum context_length in tokens. Valid only for models, embedding_models, eu_models, endpoints, zdr_endpoints. Missing/non-numeric fields do not match. Decimal integer notation only.

parameters.name: max_prompt_price
parameters.description: Maximum pricing.prompt in USD per token, NOT per million tokens. Valid only for models, embedding_models, eu_models, endpoints, zdr_endpoints. Decimal notation without sign or exponent. Missing/null prices do not match. Does not interpret image endpoint price arrays or video SKU prices. Negative upstream prices (for example router sentinel -1) are treated as unknown and excluded, while their raw values remain preserved.

parameters.name: free
parameters.description: Valid only for models, embedding_models, eu_models, endpoints, zdr_endpoints. true requires numeric prompt and completion prices both zero; false requires both present and at least one nonzero. Unknown prices are neither free nor paid. Negative prompt or completion prices (including router sentinel -1) are unknown and match neither true nor false.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Numbers sort numerically, missing values last in either direction. Identity is the ascending tie-breaker. Record identity uses model_id, id, slug, name, guid, then link. published_at parses row.published_at when present, otherwise RSS pubDate, into a chronological timestamp; missing/invalid dates always sort last. For pricing.prompt, negative upstream sentinel prices are treated as unknown and always sort last in either direction; raw rows retain the original negative values. Statistical numeric sorts address only the named scalar row field; nested payload values are not flattened or guessed. date uses the same scalar timestamp precedence as since/until. Native unit meanings vary; _source.units=unspecified remains unknown.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Primary sort direction.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size; decimal integer notation only.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of filtered/ordered rows or buckets to skip; zero based.

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Exact _source.window label(s), comma-separated. This filters already captured source variants; it does not ask upstream for an arbitrary historical window.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Exact captured source metric(s), for example tokens, tokens_excl_byok, requests or spend. Units remain in _source.units; spend values without a declared unit are not renamed USD.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Exact captured view(s), commonly day/week/month. A view label is not a promise that every nested chart has that grain; inspect _source and payload.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Exact _source.kind value(s), for example model_activity, listed-pricing or modality_chart. Discover actual values through dimensions/catalogue and records.

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: Exact _source.section value(s), such as globalRankingMap or a history source section; different sections can overlap.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Exact app group(s), commonly coding, creative, productivity or entertainment; source rank lists remain bounded.

parameters.name: subcategory
parameters.description: Exact captured app subcategory value(s); include low-count categories when present, without inventing records for empty results.

parameters.name: modality
parameters.description: Exact _source.routeSegment/modality value(s), commonly text,image,embeddings,rerank,video,speech,decisions,transcription. This filters source rows, not nested payload models.

parameters.name: app
parameters.description: Exact public application ID(s) present on scalar app rows. Does not recursively slice a per-model top_apps payload.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Inclusive record-time lower bound: real UTC date or ISO timestamp with timezone. Uses scalar date, then published_at, pubDate, then numeric Unix created. Rows without a scalar timestamp are excluded. Nested charts/analytics are not trimmed; this cannot backfill history.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Inclusive record-time upper bound; a YYYY-MM-DD value includes that entire UTC day. Same scalar timestamp rules as since; must be on/after since. No recursive chart filtering or upstream historical fetch.
